name: STC-80XGO.docx
path: Realtek Based Commercial Switch/Commercial Ethernet Switch/STC-80XGO.docx
method: python-docx(段落+表格+文本框+页眉页脚)
text:
Introduction
It adopts a storage and forwarding mechanism, and internally integrates a high capacity cache to ensure that all ports can achieve 10G non-blocking line speed forwarding for more emergency situations
With a durable and high strength fan steel shell design, the efficient heat dissipation ensures stable operation
This switch has 8*10 Gigabit SFP+ ports enjoying
1.25G/2.5G/10G rate
easy to manage and maintain
It can be widely used in security network video surveillance, hotel, campus, small and medium-sized enterprise network engineering and other occasions
Key Features
Support 8*10G SFP+optical ports
Support IEEE802.3, IEEE802.3u, IEEE802.3x, IEEE802.3ab, IEEE802.3z
Support automatic port flipping(Auto MDI/MDIX)
Adopt a storage and forwarding exchange mechanism
All ports support line speed switching
The panel indicator lights will monitor the working status and assist in fault analysis
Support QoS data priority
Support web management
Specification
Product Name	8 Port 10G SFP+ Web Managed Switch
Port	8x1.25G/2.5G/10G rate
Switching Capacity	160Gbps
Throughput	119.04Mpps
RAM	128MByte
Flash Memory	16MByte
Memory Cache	12MBit
MAC Address	16K
Jumbo Frame	12Kbytes
Transfer Mode	Store and forward
MTBF	100,000 hours
Network Protocol	IEEE 802.3: Ethernet Media Access Control(MAC)Protocol / IEEE 802.3i: 10BASE-T Ethernet / IEEE 802.3u: 100BASE-TX Fast Ethernet / IEEE 802.3ab: 1000BASE-T Gigabit Ethernet / IEEE 802.3z: 1000BASE-X Gigabit Ethernet(Fiber optic) / IEEE 802.3x: Flow Control / IEEE 802.3az(Efficient and Energy saving Ethernet) / IEEE 802.3ae(10 Gigabit Ethernet) / IEEE802.3x(Flow Control) / IEEE802.3 bz(2.5G/5G Ethernet standard)
Industry Standard	EMI: FCC Part 15, CISPR(EN55032)class A / EMS: EN61000-4-2(ESD) / EN61000-4-5(Surge)
Network Medium	10Base-T: Cat3, 4, 5 or above UTP(≤100m) / 100Base-TX: Cat5 or above UTP(≤100m) / 1000Base-TX: Cat5 or above UTP(≤100m)
Certification	CE/FCC/RoHS
Working Environment	Working Temperature: -10℃~50℃ / Storage Temperature: -40℃~70℃ / Working Humidity: 10%~90%, non-condensing / Storage Temperature: 5%~95%, non-condensing
Input Voltage	DC12V2A
Power Consumption	＜18W
LED Indicators	PWR(Power indicator) / On: power on
Off: no power / SYS(System light) / On: System On / Flashing: System Startup / SFP Port Light / Blue on: 10G link / Green on: 1000M/2500M link / Flashing: Data transmitting / Off: Link not working / Dialing / Left Side: 1 to 8 Ports have speeds of 10G/1G / Middle: 1 to 8 Ports have speeds of 10G/2.5G / Right Side: 1 to 4 Ports have speeds of 10G/1G, 5 to 8 Ports have speeds of 10G/2.5G
Dimension
Remark

Packing Information
1pc switch(neutral device)
1pc power adapter(standards vary across countries)
1pc user manual(including QIG information)
Please know that there is NOT a warranty card in the packing box
A “Warranty Certificate” will be issued to indicate the order information and warranty coverage
Shipping box information(Below information is approximately accurate)
Product size: 220*126*28mm
Inner box size: 259*228*60mm
Product weight: 0.62Kg
Packing weight: 0.86Kg
Master box size: 535*320*480mm
Packing quantity: 20Pcs
Packing weight: 18.2Kg
Remark
Accessories(optical module, patchcord etc.)are NOT included in the packing box
Please prepare it by yourself or purchase a whole set from us
Power cable is included in BOTH the packing box AND unit pricing
